reason: The patch passes "zoomvideo" to the sync endpoint (packages/app-store/zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:~92), but the app's slug is "zoom" (zoomvideo/_metadata.ts:16; seed-app-store.ts:294 has createApp("zoom", "zoomvideo", ...)). The new webhook looks the app up with prisma.app.findUnique({ where: { slug: reqBody.appSlug } }) (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:~42), so "zoomvideo" returns 404, and changing it to "zoom" would still fail the later appStoreMetadata lookup, which uses folder names (~line 52).
